system.description: Available in a rainbow of colors, guidance flares emit a vibrantly colored smoke that lingers for up to 10 minutes in low-wind conditions. Used by some Tau’ri militaries to allow infantry to guide aircraft strikes, these flares have found a secondary duty in scouting unknown worlds and communicating over distance when tactical radio signals are unreliable. A guidance flare can be held in hand, emitting smoke for up to 30 seconds and then remaining visible at the user’s location. It can also be fired from a flare gun (contained with the flares) up to a height of 300m for increased visibility.
